manuka.title: Manuka
paragraphs: A bit about me:

Kia Ora! My name is Mr Manuka! I'm one of the newest horses at Hack Farm and I looove cuddles and scratches with other horses and humans. My best friend is Arnie and together we are always getting up to all sorts of mischief and love entertaining our guests. I still need a little bit of guidance on the trail because if it's up to me I love exploring whenever I can! I'm quickly learning my job though and have recently graduated to an official member of the Hack Farm team! See you soon for some horsey adventures on the beach at Golden Bay. mcduff.title: McDuff
paragraphs: A bit about me:

I came here 2019 to help with the riders. Well, I took my chance to climb from the bottom of ther herd to one of the top positions in no time. My size may helped a lllllittle bit. I thought that feels better for my middle age now. I have fun going along with my herd, love to boss the odd hack around but still get afraid if I see a seal or new boat on the beach. Man, that things look and smell so diffent than the cows and tracktors around the farm in Canterbury. They say I will get used to it, Right! Always a marvellous ride along the stunning reef ...

headings: Nickname | Beautiful Brunner the One Eyed Wonder
paragraphs: A bit about me:

I had an accident when I was baby and damaged one of my eyes. Bumma, some mistakes are we doing just once, eh? I am very elegant. I lower my head a bit more to check things out and love to go for a lovely ride along the sands. Crawling over the rocks is not what I like most, a roll in the sand instead would be juuuuust fine. I even don't mind if you sit on me :) Name: Beautiful Brunner Breed: Appaloosa...

arnie.title: Arnie
paragraphs: A bit about me:

I'm an Austrian, born 2015, isn't that all you need to know? Some say I am the cutest here and I can't argue with that. But sometimes they forget how smart I am as well... there's no fence or gate that can hold me. I am still pretty young and need to learn a few things (i.e. not to roll in the sand with a rider on board). However that should not be a problem. I'm an Aaaaustrian remember.
